title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Policy Recommendation panel
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, default state, licensing context and role-group controls are supported. The assertion that this is not a new detection goes beyond the sources; smaller corrections concern the analytics switch's full path, a billing citation and the action rating.

claims.claim: The analytics control is reached in Microsoft Purview through Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Analytics.
claims.quote:
Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page.
3. Select Insider Risk Management to go to the Insider Risk Management settings.
4. Under Insider risk settings, select Analytics, and then turn off the setting.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct settings page but stops before its switch. Set controls[1].ui.path and the rendered path to "Settings > Insider Risk Management > Insider risk settings > Analytics > Scan your tenant's user activity to identify potential insider risks". The final label is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-configure#step-3-optional-enable-and-view-insider-risk-analytics-insights, already cited by the briefing.
